description: Design reference from the Signal Flow prototype (Claude Design export, inline styles). The React version is not built yet, so rebuild this structure with the listed Carbon components and --at-* tokens; do not copy the prototype markup, which fails validate_page. Research Projects home: a grid of pastel project cards (colour from a --at-tint-* token stored on the project), each showing sessions, themes and high-priority counts, and a derived Draft or Analyzed Tag. The whole card is one action (ClickableTile); the per-card menu (change colour, remove) is an OverflowMenu. Remove asks for confirmation in a Modal and is a hard delete.
